selections.name: go-api-contracts
selections.reason: Clamp is exported with an established README contract. Repair restores its documented inclusive behavior while retaining the exact signature and module minimum; existing external-package tests exercise the consumer boundary.

selections.name: go-core-style
selections.reason: Writing and formatting Go production and ordinary test code.

selections.name: go-interfaces-and-composition
selections.reason: No interface, dependency, constructor, options, wiring, or lifecycle changes; only a pure expression and guard repair.

selections.name: go-package-boundaries
selections.reason: Package responsibilities, ownership, placement, and import direction remain unchanged.

selections.name: go-test-isolation
selections.reason: Pure deterministic calculation with local integer inputs and ordinary assertions; no files, dependencies, doubles, shared mutable state, goroutines, timers, fixtures, or parallel execution.
